description: Thermische Energie Drinkwater (TED - potentie) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De laag TED- potentie toont het potentieel aan onttrekbare warmte van drinkwaterleidingen.. Waterbedrijven leverden de data voor het berekenen van de TED-potentie. Zie ook de voor meer informatie. Data afkomstig uit de Landelijke tabellen van de Aquathermieviewer. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are ted-potentie, thermische-energie-drinkwater. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG. The portal shows 2025-04-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
